name: media-paths-library-relative
body: Every template or theme reference to a library file resolves inside the resolved library. The layout `{{media "path"}}` helper takes a path relative to the resolved library's `media/`, stays within it, and names an existing file. Theme CSS — and every CSS it `@import`s — reaches the library through the reserved prefixes: `media:path` is relative to `media/` and stays within it; `theme:<name>/path` is relative to that theme's directory under `themes/` and stays within it. A reference without a prefix is relative to the referencing CSS file's own location and must stay inside the library root. In every form a missing file is a templates error; an absolute path, a `..` escaping its tree, any other scheme, an unknown `theme:<name>`, and a reference outside the library are templates errors — theme-CSS violations qualified with the offending CSS file:line, layout violations with the layout's file:line. `media` resolves only within the `media/` tree — never into a `themes/` directory; a theme reaches another theme only through the explicit `theme:<name>/` prefix. Within the library this preserves the self-contained/relocatable property (global.constraint.template-library-shareable).
